critical_mismatches: Massive omission/garbling of Ludovic’s biography and other speaker introductions — candidate repeats a nonsensical phrase (“je peux te présenter ton parcours d'embrou” many times) and drops all meaningful career details.
Company name/history mistranscribed — reference: “compagnie fromagère de la vallée de lens”; candidate: garbled/incorrect phrasing (“compagnie de fromagerie de la base de l'ornz” or similar).
Safety and evacuation instructions (alarm procedure, exits, defibrillator, circulation/glissade/risks) present in reference are largely missing from candidate transcript.

Packaging/RSE/Tesco discussion is corrupted and partly hallucinated — reference discusses polystyrène, polypropylène, Tesco and switch to carton pelliculé; candidate introduces “ups” repeatedly and misstates materials (polypropène) and repeats unrelated phrases (economy is in train of exploding).
Many numeric and factual details omitted or lost (years, number of children, accident-day counts, specific site projects and locations) which change or remove factual content.
rationale: The candidate preserves only small, disjointed fragments of the original (opening about a short presentation and lunch time) but omits or garbles most meaningful content: speaker biographies, safety rules, historical/company facts, and detailed RSE/packaging discussion. It also inserts repetitive, nonsensical phrasing and several incorrect names/terms (e.g., ‘ups’ instead of Tesco/polystyrène), amounting to major semantic loss and some hallucinations. Therefore the transcript is largely inaccurate.
